Privacy

Afterkeep is a guide directory. We never collect your accounts, passwords or documents, and you don't need an account to use the site.

Google Analytics

We use Google Analytics 4 to understand anonymous usage: pages viewed, rough location, device type and clicks on outbound or affiliate links. Google Analytics sets cookies in your browser. We use it only for site statistics. You can block it with a browser extension or Google's opt-out add-on ↗; the site still works. See Google's privacy policy ↗.

Newsletter (FormSubmit)

If you sign up for updates, your email address is sent through FormSubmit to our inbox (Afterkeep800@gmail.com). We use it only to send occasional policy-change updates. Reply to unsubscribe and we'll delete it.

Sponsorship checkout (Stripe)

Businesses that buy a sponsorship pay through Stripe Checkout. Stripe processes the payment details and the business details entered at checkout; we never see full card numbers. See Stripe's privacy policy ↗.

Contact

Questions or deletion requests: Afterkeep800@gmail.com.
